content.snl: def-struct-hyp(Type.annotation(@F,Type.to(Type,Type)),Type.covariant(F),struct[enumerate](member[colon](%map%,%for every f : A → B, a map F(f) : F(A) → F(B)% ),member[colon](%identity law%,%F(id_A)=id_{F(A)}%),member[colon](%composition law%,%F(g ∘ f)=F(g) ∘ F(f)%)))

values.en: A covariant functor sends f : A → B to F(f) : F(A) → F(B), preserving identities and composition in the same order. In positivity calculations, a covariant type constructor preserves the polarity of occurrences in its argument.
values.zh-CN: 协变函子把 f : A → B 映为 F(f) : F(A) → F(B)，并按相同顺序保持恒等态射与复合。在正性计算中，协变类型构造子保持其参数中各出现的极性。
